note: State recreation area on a grassy point of Lake Oahe, 3 mi SW of Pollock off SD-1804. The west and south rows look across shore grass to the lake; the east loops sit among shelterbelts. Boat ramp and fish-cleaning station; fall pheasant, grouse and waterfowl hunters camp here. --Claude
